sections.Profile:
Flipper Foxtrot Rhythm Explosion, developed by For Amusement Only Games and released in January 2022, is a rhythm-based pinball game designed for Multimorphic's P³ platform, utilizing the Cannon Lagoon playfield module. Players select from nearly 30 songs across various genres and match button presses to on-screen prompts, with timing accuracy affecting both scores and in-game health. Mistimed inputs launch balls onto the playfield, requiring players to make specific shots to regain health, blending rhythm mechanics with traditional pinball action
